text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...It's about time to head home.
Yeah, I definitely got more done than usual.
I can really feel the difference."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Still...
'If you get bored of it, you can just quit,' huh.
Haha, sounds like you really thought this through."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence! Hello.
Are you out hiking too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: A hike... Or rather, knowing SteGo-san, could she just be in the middle of a journey?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yo, you two.
This is supposed to be training, more or less.
My Trainer set it up for me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
They say a change of scenery changes your mood.
Thanks to that, I made good progress.
I'm about to head home now, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Since you're here, wanna try it too?
My special training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"No, no!
We're just on our way home too.
If anything, we'd love it if you could tell us a shortcut..."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That works out nicely then.
See that rope over there?
I've used it back and forth a few times; it's quite sturdy.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
At the top of this cliff,
there's a mountain stream. If we walk along it,
we can get back faster than the usual route.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thinking all the way ahead to our trip home...
My Trainer's pretty considerate, wouldn't you say? Haha.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
C-Climbing the cliff with a rope over and over...!?
S-Sasuga, that's incredible! We can't afford to lose either.
Right, Mirako-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeehh!?
You really didn't need to push yourself so hard here of all places~~~!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"This'll shave off a whole hour.
Right, let's get moving. Good company makes the journey shorter."
